market_question: Will the price of Bitcoin be above $72,000 on May 17?
reasoning: Bitcoin price on a specific day two years from now has high uncertainty; the current market implies near-certainty of >$72k, which overlooks bear market cycles and volatility. Historical patterns suggest a possible post-halving peak in 2025 followed by a correction, making a price above $72k in May 2026 far from guaranteed.
evidence_points: Bitcoin historically enters bear markets in the year following the post-halving peak (e.g., 2014, 2018, 2022)
Current implied probability of 99.9% ignores tail risks and timing volatility
Long-dated binary predictions have low signal-to-noise; a specific day adds randomness
